# UI & Styling Conventions (Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui)

## Stack

- **Tailwind CSS v4**, imported CSS-first in
  [app/globals.css](/Users/achyutanantapanda/Documents/MERN/link-shortner/app/globals.css) via `@import "tailwindcss"` —
  there is **no `tailwind.config.ts`**. Theme tokens (`--color-*`,
  `--radius-*`, etc.) are defined with `@theme inline` and CSS custom
  properties directly in `globals.css`. Add new design tokens there, not in
  a config file.
- **shadcn/ui** (`style: "base-nova"`, `baseColor: "neutral"`, icons via
  `lucide-react`) generates components into `components/ui/`. Configuration
  lives in [components.json](/Users/achyutanantapanda/Documents/MERN/link-shortner/components.json).
- Component primitives come from `@base-ui/react` (e.g. `Button` wraps
  `@base-ui/react/button`), styled with `class-variance-authority` (`cva`)
  for variants, matching [components/ui/button.tsx](/Users/achyutanantapanda/Documents/MERN/link-shortner/components/ui/button.tsx).
- Class name merging uses the `cn` package (re-exported from
  [lib/utils.ts](/Users/achyutanantapanda/Documents/MERN/link-shortner/lib/utils.ts)) — always wrap conditional/merged class
  lists in `cn(...)` instead of manual string concatenation or template
  literals with ternaries.

## Adding components

- **Never hand-roll a UI primitive.** Buttons, inputs, dialogs, cards,
  dropdowns, etc. must always be shadcn/ui components — generate missing
  ones with the shadcn CLI (`npx shadcn@latest add <component>`) instead of
  writing raw `<button>`/`<input>`/styled `<a>`/hand-rolled modal markup.
  This applies everywhere, including one-off UI (e.g. the header's sign
  in/sign up buttons) — there's no "just this once" exception for a plain
  HTML element with Tailwind classes.
- App-specific composed UI (a "short link card", "create link form") is
  fine and belongs directly under `components/` — but it must be built by
  composing shadcn/ui primitives (`Card`, `Input`, `Button`, etc.), not by
  writing new raw HTML/Tailwind markup that duplicates what a primitive
  already provides. Keep `components/ui/` itself limited to the generic
  primitives generated by the shadcn CLI.
- Follow the existing `cva` variant pattern for any new primitive that has
  visual variants (`variant`, `size`, etc.) rather than branching with
  if/else class strings.

## Styling rules

- Use Tailwind utility classes directly in JSX; avoid introducing a
  separate CSS-in-JS solution or new global stylesheet.
- Support dark mode using the existing `dark:` variant convention (theme is
  driven by the `.dark` class per the `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`
  rule in `globals.css`) — don't hardcode light-only colors on new
  user-facing UI.
- Reuse theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `bg-primary`,
  etc.) instead of raw Tailwind palette colors (`bg-zinc-50`,
  `text-black`) so new UI stays themeable; the boilerplate `app/page.tsx`
  still uses raw colors because it's un-customized starter content — don't
  copy that pattern into new pages.
- Icons: use `lucide-react`, matching the `iconLibrary` configured in
  `components.json`.
